stereotypeDefinition.comment: The constructor's access modifier as the code declares it, e.g. protected for a constructor only EF Core uses. Without it, a constructor is public. Constructor signatures are fully managed under Merge, so it must match the code. Ignored on a Primary Constructor, which has no access modifier of its own.
stereotypeDefinition.name: Constructor Configuration

property.hint: The constructor's access modifier as the code declares it. A constructor declared without one is private, so model it as private. Empty means public.
property.name: Access Modifier
